control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
provision and briefing of a competent fire watch
alarm, muster and accounting for people

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during a planned shutdown on SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control MUSTER_AND_ACCOUNTING: the alarm, muster and accounting for people was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on SG-3100 and TX-3001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the alarm, muster and accounting for people on SG-3100 and TX-3001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in mustering and rescuing, specifically deploying an emergency response team. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 28 December 2008 an incident occurred on SG-3100 and TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
